title: HCLTech named as one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies® by Ethisphere for third consecutive year - The HinduBusinessLine
summary: HCLTech, a global technology company, has been recognized as one of the 2026 World’s Most Ethical Companies by Ethisphere, marking the third consecutive year of this achievement. The recognition highlights HCLTech's commitment to ethical business practices and its integration of core values into its operations.
sentiment_reason: The sentiment is strongly positive because the company has been recognized as one of the World's Most Ethical Companies for three consecutive years, which is a major achievement and reflects positively on its reputation and business practices.
